args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. 1 flagged, 7 cleared.
Flagged: r03, because a check failed but the run was accepted anyway. Its closure value is 2.769 against a threshold of 1.0, yet the check is recorded as passed. Its profile also differs from the batch: the largest flank difference is at 21 µm instead of 84 µm, and the growth zone is 695 µm instead of 684 µm.
Cleared: r01, r02, r04, r05, r06, r07, r08. All their checks pass, and their REGR peaks (53.1–53.24 %/h at 421 µm) and growth zones (674–684 µm) match the batch. In r04, r05 and r06 the flank difference is negative, but plane sections passes, so the root is bending the other way and the measurement is not at fault.
What the flagged run shows: with only r03 flagged, there is no shared pattern. r03 used the width-free ratio, so plane sections was not run. That left closure and the profile shape as the evidence, and both point to a problem with the tip velocity and strain-rate profile.
Note: some runs have exactly the same checks and summaries (r01, r02, r07 and r08; r04 and r06). Check that these are separate roots or time windows and not duplicate entries.
